last_material_result: One bounded fresh discovery/assessment unit tested a Korea Appliance Repair-vs-Replace Calculator: repair quote + appliance age + replacement price + remaining useful life + energy-cost delta => annualized repair-vs-replace break-even. The underlying consumer decision is real and measurable, but the wedge fails competition differentiation. Korean search results already contain a near-identical 2026 repair-vs-replace annualized-cost method and a dedicated appliance replacement BEP calculator supporting major appliance categories; global incumbents additionally offer repair-vs-replace calculators with live prices, model data and confidence scoring. Tried three differentiations conceptually: simple 50%-rule replacement, remaining-life annualized cost, and energy-savings/BEP. All are already represented by substitutes. KILL rather than build a redundant calculator.
economics: Research spend KRW0. A static implementation would be KRW0, but expected organic acquisition is weak because exact calculator substitutes already rank and richer global products exist. Affiliate monetization could be plausible in theory, but insufficient differentiation makes expected contribution too low relative even to small maintenance cost.
